translations.translatedText: # Thursday 16.7.2020 (radio)
A serious traffic accident in Parkano. EU countries disagree about corona aid. Fraud crimes are increasing. More student flats are available than before. It is warm on Friday.
The TV Clear News has a summer break. It will continue on 17.8.
The radio Clear News is made every day, including in summer.
## Serious traffic accident in Parkano
![Accident site in Parkano.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11450879)
Open image viewer
The accident happened in Parkano. Photo: Tommi Pylkkö / Yle
A serious traffic accident has happened in Parkano in Pirkanmaa.
At least 2 people died when a lorry and 2 cars collided. Many people were also injured in the accident. The accident happened on main road 3 in the morning.
The police are investigating why the 2 cars and the lorry collided in Parkano.
## EU countries disagree on corona aid
![Prime Minister Sanna Marin arrived at the government negotiations at the Säätytalo in Helsinki on 8 July.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11450489)
Open image viewer
Prime Minister Sanna Marin represents Finland at the EU meeting. Photo: Jussi Nukari / Lehtikuva

EU country leaders will negotiate on Friday and Saturday about how the EU will help different countries with money in the corona crisis. Prime Minister **Sanna Marin** is taking part in the meeting from Finland.

Marin says that different EU countries want to share support in different ways. It is hard for EU countries to agree on how much support, which countries may keep, and how much loan, which must be paid back, is given.
Finland wants to change the aid package so that the EU gives more loans, which countries must pay back. Finland does not want the EU to give a lot of money that countries may keep.
## Fraud crimes increasing
![Computer keyboard and code.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10600153)
Open image viewer
Many frauds are committed over the internet. Photo: Ismo Pekkarinen / AOP

Fraud crimes have increased. In the first half of the year, that is January to June, Finns reported to the police over 20,000 different fraud crimes. That is 10% more than in January to June last year.
In particular, people over 65 are being cheated more than before. They are often cheated over the internet.
Fraud crimes committed against people over 65 have doubled compared with last year.
## Plenty of student flats available
![KOAS's tower block "Maitopurkki" and other new apartment blocks in Kangas, Jyväskylä.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10365007)
Open image viewer
The high student flat block of the Central Finland student housing foundation has been nicknamed the "milk carton". Photo: Arvo Vuorela / Yle

There are now many vacant student flats in Finland. There are more vacant student flats than before, because the corona situation means that only a few exchange students are coming to Finland from abroad.
Young people have also applied for student flats less than before, because many study places are being decided later than usual this year.
Many higher education institutions have moved to distance teaching because of the corona situation, but this has not affected applications for student flats.
## Weather

![View opening from the back yard of a manor towards the town of Uudenkaarlepyy, where the famous church rooster is also located.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10339106)
Open image viewer
On Friday it is quite warm. Showers may come, but there will not be much rain. Photo: Clarissa Jäärni / Yle
On Friday in Eastern Finland the sky is clear. Elsewhere there are a few clouds. In Western and Northern Finland a few showers may come.
The temperature on Friday is between 20 and 25 degrees.
